title: 第十四章  看你怎么输！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这时候，丞相孙承上也站出来了。

“陛下，皇后娘娘说得在理。”

“公主和驸马爷成亲这么久，一直没个一儿半女。”

“外头都传遍了，说两人压根没同过房，分居两处。”

“感情不和拖着，对谁都没好处。”

“臣建议，公主和驸马还是和离为好。”

六皇子也跟着上前凑热闹：

“父皇，儿臣也觉着，璇玑与林澈和离，那是最佳选择。”

眼见六皇子开口。

跟随六皇子的朝臣立刻附议。

“臣附议！”

“臣也附议！”

林澈看着满朝文武这副嘴脸，恶心得差点没把早饭吐出来。

说实在的，他自己也想跟公主和离。

但是看着这帮人一个个上赶着要拆散他的婚姻，他这暴脾气就上来了。

“诸位大人...”

林澈不紧不慢地开了腔：

“我和公主感情好不好，那是我的家事。”

“你们怕是管不着吧？”

“再说了，我林澈从来没做过对不起公主的事，也没伤害过她半分。”

“凭什么要和离？”

之前嘛，借着跟丫鬟私通那档子事，这帮人既能置他于死地，又能光明正大地撺掇两人和离。

可现在呢？

那事儿还没查清楚呢，他们拿什么当理由？

感情不和？

在这年头，那算个屁的理由。

孙平早就看林澈这副嚣张的样子不顺眼了。

这小子打从进朝堂就没正眼瞧过他，今天可算逮着机会了。

“林澈，你一事无成，这是皇城里头众所周知的事实....”

“说好听点叫驸马，说难听点就是个废物！”

“公主那是金枝玉叶，你根本配不上公主！”

这一开口，朝堂上顿时炸了锅。

“没错没错，这个林澈就是彻头彻尾的废物一个！”

“公主根本瞧不上他，整个皇室上下，谁瞧得上他？”

“他连公主的脚趾头都比不上，怎么配得上公主？”

“三年了啊，他连公主的手指头都没碰过，这婚姻早该散了！”

“我跟你们说，就我们府里那些丫鬟下人，都看不上这个废物！”

一时间跟开了批斗大会似的，你一言我一语，全都在数落林澈的不是。

那阵势，感觉今日不和离，这天就要塌了。

林澈听着这些话，心里的火苗子蹭蹭往上蹿。

“你们口口声声说我是废物，好，很好！”

他一拍巴掌，声音陡然拔高：

“孙平你敢不敢跟我比试一番？”

此言一出，满座皆惊。

月天帝更是一愣，还要比试？

真输了国公府名声一落千丈！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At this time, Prime Minister Sun Chengshang also stood up.

"Your Majesty, the Queen is right."

"The princess and the prince-in-law have been married for so long, but they have never had a son or a daughter."

"It's been widely spread outside that the two of them have never slept in the same room and live in two separate places."

"It's not good for anyone to drag on with emotional discord."

"I suggest that it is best for the princess and the consort to reconcile."

The Sixth Prince also stepped forward to join in the fun:

"My father and I also feel that it is the best choice for Xuanji and Lin Che to reconcile."

Seeing the sixth prince speak.

The courtiers following the Sixth Prince immediately seconded the proposal.

"I second the proposal!"

"I also second the proposal!"

Lin Che looked at Manchao Wenwu's face and was so disgusted that she almost vomited out her breakfast.

To be honest, he himself wanted to reconcile with the princess.

But seeing these people rushing to break up his marriage one by one, his temper grew.

"My lords..."

Lin Che spoke slowly:

"Whether my relationship with the princess is good or not is my family matter."

"Are you afraid that you can't control it?"

"Besides, I, Lin Che, have never done anything to be sorry for the princess, nor have I ever hurt her in the slightest."

"Why should we reconcile?"

In the past, by having an affair with the maid, these people were able to kill him and at the same time encourage the two of them to reconcile.

But now?

The matter hasn't been investigated yet, so what excuse do they use?

Discord?

In these days, that's a bullshit excuse.

Sun Ping had long been displeased with Lin Che's arrogant look.

This kid has never looked at him since he entered the court, so today is an opportunity.

"Lin Che, you have accomplished nothing. This is a well-known fact in the imperial city..."

"To put it nicely, he is called a prince-in-law, but to put it worst, he is a loser!"

"Princess, you are nothing but golden branches and jade leaves. You are not worthy of the princess at all!"

As soon as he opened his mouth, there was an explosion in the court.

"Yes, that's right, this Lin Che is a complete loser!"

"The princess doesn't look down on him at all. Who in the entire royal family can look down on him?"

"He can't even compare to the princess's toes, how can he be worthy of the princess?"

"It's been three years, and he hasn't even touched the princess's finger. This marriage should have been broken up long ago!"

"I'm telling you, even the maids and servants in our house don't look down on this good-for-nothing!"

For a moment, it was as if there was a denunciation meeting. Everything you said and I said were all criticizing Lin Che.

That formation feels like if there is no harmony today, the sky will collapse.

Listening to these words, Lin Che felt the fire in her heart rising.

"You keep saying I'm a waste, good, good!"

He clapped his hands and his voice suddenly rose:

"Sun Ping, do you dare to compete with me?"

As soon as this statement came out, everyone in the audience was shocked.

Emperor Yue Tian was even more stunned. Are you still going to compete?

If you really lose, the reputation of the Duke's Mansion will plummet!
